narrative: OMX30 opens to strong overnight carry from risk-on global flows (weighted correlation +1.36%), underpinned by NASDAQ's 2.78% surge and broad European gains. However, technicals flash overbought extremes: RSI 73.4, Stochastic K/D at 87.5/84.7, and price already 100% of 52W range with +0% from highs suggests mean reversion vulnerability. The ADX 42.5 (strong trend) supports momentum continuation, but the bond-driven yield spike (+89bps US 10Y) creates headwinds for tech/real estate while widening bank NIM. Watch for profit-taking on open given the technical setup.
morningBrief: OMX30 set to gap higher on global risk appetite, but tread carefully—we're deep in overbought territory with RSI 73.4 and Stochastic at 87.5, typical of mean reversion setups. Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo B, Sandvik) should lead on USD/SEK weakness and copper strength; Boliden a strong buy on dual gold (+0.46%) and copper (+0.96%) tailwinds. Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken, Swedbank) gain from the 89bp US yield spike widening spreads, but watch real estate (Balder, Castellum) for refinancing pressure. Tech/Telecom (Ericsson, Hexagon) lag on NASDAQ euphoria potentially pricing in DCF compression from higher rates. Key support 3085 (lower BB), resistance 3180 (50-MA). US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET is the only catalyst; geopolitical chatter (Ukraine/Patriot) remains a tail risk.
